overall_notes: This paper focuses on Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) which involves generating answers to temporal questions. The main NLG component is answer generation from retrieved temporal facts. The paper uses Hits@1 as the primary automatic evaluation metric. While LLMs are central to the approach (for generation), they are not used as judges/evaluators. No human evaluation was conducted.
